lines.text: Which animal can regrow its whole body from one tiny piece?
Here are five animals that regrow what they lose, counting down to the wildest.
Number five, the sea cucumber. When a predator attacks, it can push part of its insides out of its body to scare it off.
Then it grows them back, and in a few weeks it is good as new.
Number four, the zebrafish. Damage its heart, and it grows new heart muscle with barely any scar.
Number three, the axolotl, the smiling salamander. It can regrow a whole lost leg, and even a cut spinal cord.
Number two, the comet sea star. When one arm breaks off, that arm can grow an entire new body.
And number one, the planarian, a tiny flatworm. Cut it into pieces, and the pieces can grow into whole new worms, each with a head and a tail.
Scientists have even rebuilt a whole worm from a single stem cell.
So if you could borrow one of these powers, which would you pick?
